title.zh-CN: 右腿疼痛、麻木 6 小时 · 29岁男性
title.en: Right leg pain and numbness for six hours · 29-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位年轻男性右腿疼痛、麻木 6 小时：判断这条腿受到多大威胁，追查问题从哪里开始，再决定先处理什么。
summary.en: A young man with six hours of pain and numbness in his right leg: judge how threatened the leg is, trace where the problem begins and decide what to treat first.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从苍白、发凉、远端动脉搏动消失并伴麻木和活动障碍的下肢识别急性动脉缺血，按 ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南（改良 Rutherford 分级）判定为“即刻受威胁”，并与深静脉血栓和单纯骨筋膜室综合征鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise acute arterial ischaemia in a pale, cold leg with absent distal pulses, numbness and weakness, grade it as immediately threatened (ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline, modified Rutherford categories) and tell it apart from deep-vein thrombosis and isolated compartment syndrome.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把股动脉搏动减弱和超声所见的腹主动脉-髂动脉受累理解为可能起自主动脉的流入道问题，在溶栓或取栓之前行覆盖整条主动脉的 CT 血管成像（ESC 2024 主动脉疾病指南：疑似急性主动脉综合征首选从颈部到盆腔的增强 CT）。
learningOutcomes.en: Read a weak femoral pulse and aorto-iliac involvement on duplex as an inflow problem that may begin in the aorta, and image the whole aorta by CT angiography before any thrombolysis or embolectomy (ESC 2024 aortic guideline: contrast CT from the neck to the pelvis first in a suspected acute aortic syndrome).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把 CT 上的 A 型主动脉夹层、下肢灌注不良和 35 mmHg 的筋膜室压力整合为同一个病变，并解释为什么用全身舒张压算出的“安全”压差不能排除无血流肢体的骨筋膜室综合征。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate a type A dissection on CT, a malperfused leg and a compartment pressure of 35 mmHg into one process, and explain why a 'safe' gradient worked out from systemic diastolic pressure cannot exclude compartment syndrome in a leg without inflow.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对合并下肢灌注不良的急性 A 型夹层立即修复升主动脉，在同一次手术中复查下肢血流并行筋膜切开，术前用静脉 β 受体阻滞剂把心率降到 60–80 次/分、收缩压降到 120 mmHg 以下或能维持灌注的最低水平（ACC/AHA 2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Commit to immediate repair of the ascending aorta for acute type A dissection with leg malperfusion, with the leg's flow rechecked and its compartments decompressed in the same operation, and IV beta-blockade before theatre to a heart rate of 60–80/min and a systolic pressure below 120 mmHg or the lowest that keeps organs perfused (ACC/AHA 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 预见缺血超过 6 小时的肢体再灌注后的高钾血症、肌红蛋白尿和急性肾损伤并安排监测，认识到入院时不高的肌酐和血钾只是基线，不能用来放心。
learningOutcomes.en: Anticipate hyperkalaemia, myoglobinuria and acute kidney injury when a leg ischaemic for more than six hours is reperfused, plan the monitoring, and treat an admission creatinine and potassium that are not raised as a baseline rather than reassurance.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为 29 岁的夹层修复术后患者制订长期计划——终身主动脉影像随访、血压控制、遗传学评估和一级亲属筛查（ACC/AHA 2022）——并说明报告中的先后顺序（入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后修复主动脉）与现行做法的差别。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan life after dissection repair at 29 — lifelong aortic imaging, blood-pressure control, genetic evaluation and screening of first-degree relatives (ACC/AHA 2022) — and explain how the report's sequence (decompression 8 hours after admission, aortic repair 48 hours later) differs from current practice.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——29岁男性，右下肢疼痛、麻木 6 小时；右小腿肿胀、疼痛、苍白、较对侧凉，右股动脉搏动弱、腘动脉和足背动脉未触及，腹股沟压痛，右下肢活动障碍；入院血压 128/76 mmHg；血管超声和主动脉 CT 报告；右下肢筋膜室压力 35 mmHg；肌酐、钾和尿素；入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后行升主动脉、弓部置换及象鼻术，切开 1 周后二期缝合，术后 35 天出院——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（入院血压以外的生命体征、胸背痛、既往史、用药、感觉检查、心电图、超声心动图、肌酸激酶、乳酸、破口和分支受累情况、下肢结局）保持未知。原报告的 CT 图片带有身份信息，未获准展示。保留未决的读法：“48 小时后”没有说明从何时算起，“术后 35 天”没有说明是哪一次手术之后，腹股沟压痛没有写明侧别。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 29-year-old man with six hours of pain and numbness in the right leg; a swollen, painful, pale right calf colder than the left, a weak right femoral pulse with impalpable popliteal and dorsalis pedis pulses, groin tenderness and impaired movement of the right leg; admission blood pressure 128/76 mmHg; the vascular ultrasound and aortic CT reports; a right-leg compartment pressure of 35 mmHg; creatinine, potassium and urea; decompression 8 hours after admission, replacement of the ascending aorta and arch with an elephant-trunk procedure 48 hours later, closure one week after the incision and discharge 35 days after surgery — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs other than the admission blood pressure, chest or back pain, past history, medicines, the sensory examination, ECG, echocardiography, CK, lactate, the entry tear and branch involvement, the outcome of the leg) stays unknown. The report's CT figure carries identifiers and is withheld. Readings kept open: the '48 hours later' has no stated anchor, 'after surgery' does not say which operation, and the side of the groin tenderness is not stated.

personality.zh-CN: 29岁男性，右腿疼、发麻、不太能动，又害怕又着急；问什么答什么，句子短。他只说自己清楚的事，不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我右腿疼，发麻，都不太能动了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my right leg hurts — it's gone numb and it's hard to move.

concerns.zh-CN: 医生，我这条腿还保得住吗？
concerns.en: Doctor, am I going to lose this leg?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：右腿疼痛、发麻、不太能动，躺在推床上，害怕、着急。只回答被问到的内容；不提任何检查结果，除了“6 个钟头”不说任何数字，不编造病史、用药、过敏或别的症状——胸口、后背或肚子有没有疼过，他说不上来。手术以后的感受没有记录，被问到就说说不上来。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: his right leg hurts, is numb and is hard to move; he lies on the trolley, frightened and impatient. He answers only what he is asked, never mentions a test result or any number other than the six hours, and never invents history, medicines, allergies or other symptoms — whether his chest, back or tummy has hurt, he cannot say. How he feels after the operations is not recorded; if asked, he cannot say.

description.zh-CN: 他右腿疼痛、麻木 6 小时，刚到急诊抢救区：问清这条腿的情况，检查双下肢，安排床旁超声，决定下一步。
description.en: Six hours into pain and numbness in his right leg, he has just arrived in the ED resus area: take the story of the leg, examine both legs, arrange a bedside scan and decide what comes next.

description.zh-CN: 下一步检查已经确定。本阶段做 CT 血管成像、测筋膜室压力、送检入院血液，把结果放在一起判断，并决定和启动治疗。
description.en: The next test has been chosen. In this phase the CT angiogram is done, the compartment pressure measured and the admission bloods sent; put the results together, then decide on treatment and start it.

date.en: From admission to 35 days after surgery

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：29岁男性，右下肢疼痛、麻木 6 小时就诊。右小腿肿胀、疼痛、苍白，较对侧凉；右股动脉搏动弱，右腘动脉和足背动脉未触及，左侧相应搏动可触及；腹股沟压痛，右下肢活动障碍；入院血压 128/76 mmHg。血管超声示腹主动脉下段及右侧髂总、髂外、股动脉低回声填充，右侧腘动脉、胫前动脉、胫后动脉无血流；主动脉 CT 示 Stanford A 型主动脉夹层，髂动脉受累并有中重度管腔狭窄。右下肢筋膜室压力 35 mmHg；入院时肌酐 55.8 μmol/L，钾 3.8 mmol/L，尿素 4.9 mmol/L。入院后 8 小时切开减压；48 小时后行升主动脉、弓部置换及象鼻手术；切开 1 周后二期缝合；术后 35 天出院。本病例没有记录出院时下肢功能、肾功能、出院用药、影像随访、遗传学评估和远期结局。
text.en: Recorded course: a 29-year-old man presented with six hours of pain and numbness in the right leg. The right calf was swollen, painful, pale and colder than the left; the right femoral pulse was weak and the right popliteal and dorsalis pedis pulses could not be felt, while the corresponding left pulses could; there was groin tenderness and impaired movement of the right leg; blood pressure on admission was 128/76 mmHg. Duplex ultrasound showed hypoechoic filling of the lower abdominal aorta and the right common iliac, external iliac and femoral arteries, with no flow in the right popliteal, anterior tibial or posterior tibial arteries; aortic CT showed a Stanford type A aortic dissection with iliac involvement and moderate-to-severe narrowing of the lumen. The right leg compartment pressure was 35 mmHg; on admission, creatinine 55.8 μmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L and urea 4.9 mmol/L. A decompressive incision was made 8 hours after admission; 48 hours later the ascending aorta and arch were replaced with an elephant-trunk procedure; the incision was closed secondarily one week after it was made; he was discharged 35 days after surgery. This case does not record the function of the leg or his renal function at discharge, his discharge medicines, imaging follow-up, any genetic evaluation or the long-term outcome.

name.zh-CN: 静脉 β 受体阻滞剂控制心率和血压（艾司洛尔）
name.en: IV beta-blocker for heart rate and blood pressure (esmolol)

dose.zh-CN: 先接上监护、看到心率和血压，且没有心动过缓、低血压、心包填塞征象或重度主动脉瓣反流时：艾司洛尔 500 μg/kg 静脉注射 1 分钟，随后 50–300 μg/(kg·min) 泵入；目标心率 60–80 次/分、收缩压 < 120 mmHg，或能维持脑、肾、肠道和肢体灌注的最低血压（ACC/AHA 2022）。
dose.en: Once his heart rate and blood pressure are on the monitor, and only without bradycardia, hypotension, signs of tamponade or severe aortic regurgitation: esmolol 500 μg/kg IV over 1 minute, then 50–300 μg/kg/min by infusion; aim for a heart rate of 60–80/min and a systolic pressure below 120 mmHg, or the lowest pressure that keeps the brain, kidneys, gut and limbs perfused (ACC/AHA 2022).

response.en: The surgical team has been called and theatre is being prepared. This case does not record when the operation was decided; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 小腿四间隔筋膜切开减压

dose.zh-CN: 经内、外侧两个切口切开小腿四个筋膜室，与下肢血运重建在同一次手术中进行；切口暂不缝合，待肿胀消退后延期关闭或植皮。
dose.en: Open all four calf compartments through medial and lateral incisions, in the same operation as the leg's revascularisation; leave the wounds open for delayed closure or skin grafting once the swelling settles.

response.zh-CN: 筋膜切开已列入手术计划。实际做了什么、何时做的，见下一阶段的手术记录；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Fasciotomy is on the operating plan. What was actually done, and when, is in the operation notes in the next part of the case; this case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 术中复查右腿血流，必要时加做股-股动脉转流
name.en: Recheck flow to the right leg in theatre; femoro-femoral crossover bypass if it has not returned

dose.zh-CN: 主手术完成后，由血管外科在术中评估右下肢血流（触摸搏动、多普勒），未恢复时行股-股动脉人工血管转流。
dose.en: Once the main operation is done, the vascular surgeon checks flow to the right leg in theatre (pulses, Doppler) and, if it has not returned, adds a femoro-femoral crossover graft.

response.zh-CN: 已列入手术计划。本病例没有记录术中是否复查下肢血流，也没有记录是否另做下肢血运重建；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the operating plan. This case does not record whether flow to the leg was rechecked or a separate revascularisation of the leg was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 再灌注监测：每小时尿量、血钾、肌酸激酶、乳酸和肌酐，持续心电监护
name.en: Reperfusion watch: hourly urine output, potassium, CK, lactate and creatinine, with continuous ECG

dose.zh-CN: 留置导尿，记录每小时尿量；血流恢复后每 2–4 小时查血钾、肌酸激酶、乳酸和肌酐，持续心电监护；出现高钾或尿量减少时按急性肾损伤处理。
dose.en: A urinary catheter for hourly urine output; potassium, CK, lactate and creatinine every 2–4 hours once flow returns, with continuous ECG; treat hyperkalaemia or falling urine output as acute kidney injury.

response.zh-CN: 已列入监测计划。本病例没有记录术后的尿量、血钾、肌酸激酶、乳酸或肾功能；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the monitoring plan. This case records no post-operative urine output, potassium, CK, lactate or renal function; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 出院随访计划：影像复查、血压心率控制、伤口与下肢康复
name.en: Discharge plan: follow-up imaging, blood-pressure and heart-rate control, wound and leg rehabilitation

dose.zh-CN: 术后约 1、6、12 个月复查 CT 或磁共振血管成像，稳定后每年一次；长期控制血压和心率，以 β 受体阻滞剂为基础；切口护理和下肢康复。
dose.en: CT or MR angiography at about 1, 6 and 12 months after the operation, then yearly once stable; long-term blood-pressure and heart-rate control built on a beta-blocker; wound care and rehabilitation of the leg.

response.zh-CN: 已写入出院计划。本病例没有记录出院用药、影像随访或下肢康复；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Written into the discharge plan. This case does not record his discharge medicines, imaging follow-up or rehabilitation of the leg; it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 转诊遗传门诊，并为一级亲属安排筛查
name.en: Refer to clinical genetics, with screening offered to first-degree relatives

dose.zh-CN: 遗传咨询与相关基因检测；为父母、兄弟姐妹和子女安排影像筛查。
dose.en: Genetic counselling and testing for an inherited cause; imaging screening offered to parents, siblings and children.

response.zh-CN: 转诊已提出。本病例没有记录基因检测或家族筛查，不模拟其结果。
response.en: Referral made. This case records no genetic testing or family screening and does not simulate a result.

name.zh-CN: 经导管溶栓（尿激酶或阿替普酶）

dose.zh-CN: 经动脉导管在闭塞段内持续灌注溶栓药，数小时后造影复查。
dose.en: A thrombolytic infused through an arterial catheter into the occluded segment, with a repeat angiogram after some hours.

harm.zh-CN: 在整条主动脉成像之前溶栓：股动脉搏动减弱提示流入道病变，29 岁的患者必须先排除主动脉夹层——阻塞的可能是血栓化的夹层假腔，而不是能溶开的血栓；疑似主动脉夹层是溶栓的绝对禁忌（2025 ACC/AHA 急性冠脉综合征指南的禁忌证列表），可引起致命出血。何况这条腿已经活动障碍，等不起溶栓所需的数小时。
harm.en: Thrombolysis before the whole aorta has been imaged: a weak femoral pulse points to inflow disease, and at 29 an aortic dissection must be excluded first — what blocks the artery may be a thrombosed false lumen rather than lysable clot, and suspected aortic dissection is an absolute contraindication to fibrinolysis (2025 ACC/AHA acute coronary syndrome guideline, contraindications list); it can cause fatal bleeding. And a leg that is already weak cannot wait the hours lysis takes.

response.zh-CN: 溶栓药已开始灌注。本病例没有记录溶栓，不模拟其效果。
response.en: The lytic infusion has started. This case records no thrombolysis and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素全量静脉推注后持续泵入，按 APTT 调整。
dose.en: Unfractionated heparin as a full-dose IV bolus followed by an infusion, adjusted by the APTT.

harm.zh-CN: CT 已显示急性 A 型主动脉夹层以后再全量肝素化：ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南推荐的立即肝素针对血栓栓塞，而这条腿是被夹层压闭的，肝素打不开；他即将接受急诊开胸手术（ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议立即手术），术前全量抗凝只会增加出血。
harm.en: Full heparinisation after the CT has shown an acute type A dissection: the immediate heparin of the ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline is meant for thrombo-embolism, but this leg is starved by the dissection, which heparin cannot open; and he is going to emergency open surgery (ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance calls for immediate surgery), where full anticoagulation beforehand only adds bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已推注并开始泵入。本病例没有记录抗凝，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Heparin is in and running. This case records no anticoagulation and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 经腹股沟切开球囊导管取栓（不再做影像检查）
name.en: Groin cut-down and balloon embolectomy, without further imaging

dose.zh-CN: 经右侧腹股沟切开，用球囊导管向近端和远端取栓。
dose.en: Right groin cut-down with balloon-catheter embolectomy proximally and distally.

harm.zh-CN: 在没有对流入道和整条主动脉成像之前就经腹股沟盲目取栓：股动脉搏动减弱已经提示问题在腹股沟以上，29 岁的患者必须先排除夹层；如果这是夹层，球囊导管解除不了真腔受压，还可能进入假腔或撕破血管，同时让真正致命的近端病变继续漏诊。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对累及升主动脉的夹层合并下肢灌注不良，首先修复升主动脉。
harm.en: A blind groin embolectomy before the inflow and the whole aorta have been imaged: the weak femoral pulse already points above the groin, and at 29 a dissection must be excluded first; if this is one, a balloon catheter cannot relieve a compressed true lumen, may enter the false lumen or tear the vessel, and leaves the life-threatening proximal lesion undiagnosed. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance treats a dissection involving the ascending aorta with leg malperfusion by repairing the ascending aorta first.

response.zh-CN: 已安排手术。本病例没有记录取栓，不模拟其结果。
response.en: The operation is booked. This case records no embolectomy and does not simulate its result.

name.zh-CN: 先切开减压，48 小时后再择期手术
name.en: Decompress the leg now, operate electively after 48 hours

dose.zh-CN: 先行筋膜切开减压，主手术推迟约 48 小时，待腿和全身情况稳定后择期进行。
dose.en: Fasciotomy first; the main operation put off about 48 hours, until the leg and his general condition have settled.

harm.zh-CN: 对急性 A 型主动脉夹层推迟 48 小时手术：ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议对急性 A 型夹层紧急外科评估并立即手术，合并下肢灌注不良时立即修复升主动脉。等待期间随时可能发生破裂、心包填塞或冠状动脉受累，缺血的腿也只会越来越差。减压应与主动脉修复和下肢血运重建同时进行，而不是替代它们。
harm.en: Putting off surgery for 48 hours in an acute type A dissection: ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance calls for emergency surgical evaluation and immediate surgery, with immediate repair of the ascending aorta when a leg is malperfused. Rupture, tamponade or coronary involvement can come at any point in the wait, and the ischaemic leg only gets worse. Decompression belongs with the aortic repair and the leg's revascularisation, not in place of them.

response.zh-CN: 计划已记录。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际经过展开。
response.en: The plan is recorded. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 腔内覆膜支架修复，代替开放手术
name.en: Endovascular stent-graft repair instead of open surgery

dose.zh-CN: 经股动脉置入覆膜支架，代替开放手术。
dose.en: A covered stent graft placed through the femoral artery instead of an open operation.

harm.zh-CN: 用腔内支架代替急性 A 型夹层的开放手术：胸主动脉腔内修复（TEVAR）针对降主动脉（B 型）病变，修复不了 A 型夹层所累及的升主动脉；ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对急性 A 型夹层推荐急诊外科手术。本病例也没有记录破口位置。
harm.en: A stent graft in place of open surgery for an acute type A dissection: thoracic endovascular repair (TEVAR) treats the descending aorta (type B) and cannot repair the ascending aorta that a type A dissection involves; ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends emergency surgery for acute type A dissection. The site of the entry tear is not recorded in this case either.

response.zh-CN: 已安排腔内治疗。本病例没有记录腔内治疗，不模拟其结果；接下来的记录按实际经过展开。
response.en: Endovascular treatment is booked. This case records none and does not simulate a result; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 收入 ICU 药物治疗观察，恶化时再手术
name.en: Admit to intensive care on medical treatment; operate only if he worsens

dose.zh-CN: 收入重症监护室，静脉控制心率和血压，每小时检查下肢；腿、肾或肠道灌注恶化时再手术。
dose.en: Admit to intensive care for IV heart-rate and blood-pressure control with hourly leg checks; operate if the leg, kidneys or gut get worse.

harm.zh-CN: 急性 A 型夹层不能靠药物观察，那是无并发症 B 型夹层的处理思路。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议立即手术；他已经有下肢灌注不良和骨筋膜室综合征，等待“恶化”就是等待截肢或死亡。
harm.en: An acute type A dissection is not watched on medical treatment — that is the approach to an uncomplicated type B dissection. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends immediate surgery; with a malperfused leg and compartment syndrome already present, waiting for him to 'worsen' is waiting for amputation or death.

response.zh-CN: 已收入重症监护室。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际经过展开。
response.en: He is admitted to intensive care. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

hint.zh-CN: 这条腿缺的是动脉血、静脉回流，还是空间？哪些体征能把三者分开？它的感觉和运动还剩多少？
hint.en: Is this leg short of arterial blood, of venous drainage or of room? Which signs tell the three apart — and how much feeling and movement are left?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清右腿的症状和时间，检查双下肢（外观、皮温、动脉搏动、活动），测血压，然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask about his right leg and the timing, examine both legs (appearance, temperature, pulses, movement), take his blood pressure, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 股动脉搏动减弱说明问题在哪一层？超声看到的病变从哪里开始——你要怎样才能看到它真正的起点？
hint.en: What does a weak femoral pulse say about where the problem sits? Where does the scan show it beginning — and how would you see where it really starts?

guidance.zh-CN: 推来床旁超声机做血管超声，在床旁或病历终端阅读结果，测过血压后作答决策 2。
guidance.en: Bring the ultrasound machine for a bedside vascular scan, read it at the bedside or a records terminal, and with his blood pressure taken answer decision 2.

hint.zh-CN: 这些结果能用一个病变解释吗？对他来说，哪一处最先致命？在一条没有血流的腿上，筋膜室压力的数值又意味着什么？
hint.en: Can one process explain all of it? Which part could kill him first? And what does a compartment pressure mean in a leg that has no inflow?

guidance.zh-CN: 安排 CT 血管成像（患者要用推床送到 CT 室），测筋膜室压力，送检肾功能电解质；阅读结果后作答决策 3。
guidance.en: Arrange the CT angiogram (he goes to the CT room on his trolley), measure the compartment pressure and send the renal function and electrolytes; read them, then answer decision 3.

title.en: Decide on treatment and start it

hint.zh-CN: 两处危险，哪一处先要命？哪些事可以放在同一次麻醉里做？进手术室之前，床边要做什么，又不能做什么？
hint.en: Of the two dangers, which kills first? What can be done under the same anaesthetic — and before theatre, what must and must not happen at the bedside?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 4，再把计划付诸行动：床旁的药物、腿的处理，以及启动手术的那一步。启动手术（或你选择的其他方案）之后，病例进入记录的手术经过。
guidance.en: Answer decision 4 on the case board, then act on it: the bedside medicines, the leg, and the call that starts the operation. Once the operation (or another plan you choose) has been set in motion, the case moves on to the recorded operations.

title.zh-CN: 回顾记录的经过，安排后续
title.en: Review the recorded course and plan ahead

hint.zh-CN: 手术换掉的是哪一段，剩下的那一段怎么办？一个 29 岁的人得了这个病，还有谁需要知道？
hint.en: Which segment did the operation replace — and what about the rest? When a 29-year-old has this disease, who else needs to know?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅手术记录，作答决策 5，并安排随访和转诊。
guidance.en: Read the operation notes at a records terminal, answer decision 5, and set up the follow-up and referral.

hint.zh-CN: 他实际接受治疗的先后顺序和你的计划差在哪里？出院时这条腿怎么样，记录里写了吗？
hint.en: How does the order of his actual treatment differ from your plan — and does the record say how the leg was at discharge?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the reported course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 右腿疼痛、麻木 6 小时，活动困难。查体：右小腿肿胀、疼痛、苍白，摸上去比左侧凉；右股动脉搏动弱，右腘动脉和足背动脉未触及，左侧相应搏动可触及；右下肢活动障碍。你怎样判断这条腿？
prompt.en: Six hours of pain and numbness in the right leg, which is difficult to move. On examination the right calf is swollen, painful, pale and colder than the left; the right femoral pulse is weak and the right popliteal and dorsalis pedis pulses cannot be felt, while the left-sided pulses can; movement of the right leg is impaired. How do you read this leg?

need.zh-CN: 先问清腿的症状和起病时间，并检查双下肢的外观、皮温、动脉搏动和活动。
need.en: First take the story of the leg and its timing, and examine both legs for appearance, temperature, pulses and movement.

text.zh-CN: 急性动脉缺血，肢体受到即刻威胁：已有麻木和活动障碍，股动脉搏动减弱提示阻塞在腹股沟或更近端
text.en: Acute arterial ischaemia threatening the limb now: numbness and weakness are present, and the weak femoral pulse puts the block at the groin or above

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。苍白、发凉、远端动脉搏动消失，再加上麻木和活动障碍，就是急性肢体缺血；一旦出现运动障碍，按 ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南对 Rutherford 分级的修订至少属于 IIb 级“即刻受威胁”，需要毫不拖延地恢复血流。股动脉搏动减弱说明问题在流入道——髂动脉或更近端，下一步要查清阻塞从哪里开始。
feedback.en: Correct. Pallor, coldness and absent distal pulses with numbness and weakness are acute limb ischaemia; once there is a motor deficit the leg is at least 'immediately threatened' (category IIb in the ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline's modification of Rutherford's categories) and needs its blood flow restored without delay. A weak femoral pulse places the problem in the inflow — the iliac arteries or above — so the next step is to find where the block begins.

text.zh-CN: 广泛下肢深静脉血栓：小腿肿胀、疼痛、发白，符合“股白肿”，先抗凝，再做静脉超声确认
text.en: Extensive deep-vein thrombosis: a swollen, painful, white calf fits phlegmasia alba dolens, so anticoagulate first and confirm it with a venous scan

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。深静脉血栓可以让小腿肿胀、疼痛甚至发白，但通常不会让股动脉搏动减弱、远端动脉摸不到、整条腿发凉——这些说明动脉流入受阻。ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南要求对缺血的腿立即评估血运重建；当作静脉血栓处理会错过时间窗。
feedback.en: No. Deep-vein thrombosis can make a calf swollen, painful and even pale, but it does not usually weaken the femoral pulse, take away the distal pulses and leave the leg cold — those mean arterial inflow is blocked. The ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline asks for immediate assessment for revascularisation of an ischaemic leg; treating it as venous thrombosis loses that window.

text.zh-CN: 单纯的小腿骨筋膜室综合征：肿胀疼痛的小腿是病因，远端动脉摸不到是筋膜室压力压迫所致，减压后搏动会恢复
text.en: Compartment syndrome of the calf on its own: the swollen, painful calf is the cause, the impalpable distal pulses come from compartment pressure, and decompression will bring them back

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。骨筋膜室综合征时远端动脉搏动往往仍可触及，而筋膜室压力也不会让腹股沟处的股动脉搏动减弱。这里肿胀的小腿更可能是缺血的结果而不是原因；ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南把骨筋膜室综合征作为缺血和血运重建的并发症处理，首先要解决缺血的源头。
feedback.en: No. In compartment syndrome the distal pulses are often still palpable, and compartment pressure cannot weaken the femoral pulse at the groin. The swollen calf here is more likely a result of the ischaemia than its cause; the ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline handles compartment syndrome as a complication of ischaemia and revascularisation, so the source of the ischaemia comes first.

text.zh-CN: 急性缺血但肢体仍可存活（Rutherford I 级）：先给肝素，24 小时内安排影像检查和择期处理
text.en: Acute ischaemia in a still-viable limb (Rutherford category I): heparin now, with imaging and a planned procedure within 24 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。I 级要求没有感觉丧失、没有肌力减退；他已经麻木、活动障碍，按 ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南的分级至少属于 IIb 级，需要立即恢复血流，而不是在 24 小时内择期处理。
feedback.en: No. Category I means no sensory loss and no weakness; he is numb and cannot move the leg properly, which puts him at IIb or worse in the ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline's grading — immediate restoration of flow, not a plan within 24 hours.

prompt.zh-CN: 床旁超声：腹主动脉下段及右侧髂总、髂外、股动脉管腔内低回声填充；右侧腘动脉、胫前动脉、胫后动脉无血流。入院血压 128/76 mmHg。下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Bedside duplex: hypoechoic material fills the lower abdominal aorta and the right common iliac, external iliac and femoral arteries; there is no flow in the right popliteal, anterior tibial or posterior tibial arteries. Blood pressure on admission 128/76 mmHg. What do you do next?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，做床旁血管超声并测血压。
need.en: First answer decision 1, then do the bedside vascular scan and take his blood pressure.

text.zh-CN: 立即行 CT 血管成像，从颈部一直扫到双足；请血管外科到场；在 CT 显示主动脉之前，不溶栓、不取栓
text.en: CT angiography now, from the neck down to the feet, with the vascular surgeon present; no thrombolysis or embolectomy until the scan has shown the aorta

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。超声显示病变已经累及腹主动脉下段，这不是单纯的股动脉栓塞：29 岁的人出现主动脉-髂动脉受累，必须想到主动脉夹层，而夹层可以从胸主动脉开始。ESC 2024 主动脉疾病指南把尽早行从颈部到盆腔的心电门控增强 CT 作为疑似急性主动脉综合征的首选检查（这里向下扫到双足以显示下肢）；在这之前溶栓或盲目取栓，可能在夹层的主动脉上造成严重伤害。
feedback.en: Correct. The duplex shows the process reaching the lower abdominal aorta, so this is not a simple femoral embolus: aorto-iliac involvement at 29 must raise aortic dissection, which can begin in the chest. The ESC 2024 aortic guideline makes early ECG-gated contrast CT from the neck to the pelvis the first-line test for a suspected acute aortic syndrome (run on to the feet here to show the leg), and thrombolysis or a blind embolectomy before that scan can do serious harm in a dissected aorta.

text.zh-CN: 立即经导管溶栓：超声已经找到了闭塞部位，溶栓开通髂动脉和股动脉比再做一次检查更快
text.en: Catheter-directed thrombolysis now: the duplex has already found the occlusion, and lysis will open the iliac and femoral arteries faster than another scan

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。29 岁患者主动脉里的低回声“填充”，可能是血栓化的夹层假腔，而不是能溶开的血栓；疑似主动脉夹层是溶栓的绝对禁忌（2025 ACC/AHA 急性冠脉综合征指南的禁忌证列表）。而且这条腿已经活动障碍，溶栓起效需要的数小时就是缺血的数小时。
feedback.en: No. Hypoechoic 'filling' in a 29-year-old's aorta may be a thrombosed false lumen rather than lysable clot, and suspected aortic dissection is an absolute contraindication to fibrinolysis (2025 ACC/AHA acute coronary syndrome guideline, contraindications list). In a leg that is already weak, the hours lysis takes to work are hours of ischaemia.

text.zh-CN: 直接送手术室，经右侧腹股沟切开行球囊导管取栓：已经出现运动障碍，没有时间再做影像检查
text.en: Straight to theatre for a right groin cut-down and balloon embolectomy: with a motor deficit there is no time for more imaging

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。运动障碍确实要求尽快恢复血流，但超声已经提示病变累及主动脉：如果是夹层，经腹股沟取栓解除不了真腔受压，导管还可能进入假腔或撕破血管，真正致命的胸部病变则继续漏诊。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对累及升主动脉、合并下肢灌注不良的夹层，首先修复升主动脉——前提是先用 CT 把它找出来。
feedback.en: No. A motor deficit does demand quick restoration of flow, but the duplex already shows the process reaching the aorta: if it is a dissection, a groin embolectomy cannot relieve a compressed true lumen, the catheter may enter the false lumen or tear the vessel, and the lesion in the chest that can kill him stays undiagnosed. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance repairs the ascending aorta first when a dissection involving it malperfuses a leg — once a CT has found it.

text.zh-CN: 全量静脉肝素抗凝，24 小时后复查超声，看血栓是否进展，再决定是否手术
text.en: Full-dose IV heparin and a repeat duplex in 24 hours to see whether the clot spreads before deciding on surgery

feedback.en: No. The ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline does recommend immediate heparin for acute limb ischaemia, but heparin never replaces restoring flow: a leg that is already weak cannot wait 24 hours. And with the duplex showing the process reaching the aorta at 29, a dissection has to be excluded before he is anticoagulated — the CT of the whole aorta that settles it takes minutes; once it shows a dissection, full heparin no longer fits and only adds bleeding before surgery.
feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南确实推荐对急性肢体缺血立即给予肝素，但肝素从来不能代替恢复血流：已经活动障碍的腿等不了 24 小时。而且超声显示病变已累及 29 岁患者的主动脉，抗凝之前要先排除夹层——给整条主动脉做 CT 只需几分钟；一旦 CT 显示夹层，全量肝素就不再适合，只会在手术前增加出血。

text.zh-CN: 只做腹部、盆腔和双下肢的 CT 血管成像，用来规划这条腿的血运重建；胸部和腿的缺血没有关系，不需要扫描
text.en: CT angiography of the abdomen, pelvis and legs only, to plan the leg's revascularisation; the chest has nothing to do with this leg and need not be scanned

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，不过这是最接近正确的选择。下肢 CT 血管成像能显示阻塞在哪里，但超声已经提示病变累及主动脉；如果是夹层，决定生死的是升主动脉和主动脉弓，从腹部开始扫描会把它漏掉。ESC 2024 主动脉疾病指南对疑似急性主动脉综合征要求从颈部到盆腔成像。
feedback.en: No — but the nearest miss. A run-off CT angiogram shows where the leg is blocked, but the duplex shows the process reaching the aorta; if this is a dissection, what decides his survival is the ascending aorta and arch, which a scan starting at the abdomen would miss. The ESC 2024 aortic guideline images a suspected acute aortic syndrome from the neck to the pelvis.

prompt.zh-CN: CT 血管成像：Stanford A 型主动脉夹层，髂动脉受累，管腔中重度狭窄。右下肢筋膜室压力 35 mmHg。入院时肌酐 55.8 μmol/L，钾 3.8 mmol/L，尿素 4.9 mmol/L。哪一种解释能把这些结果都说通？
prompt.en: CT angiography: Stanford type A aortic dissection, with iliac involvement and moderate-to-severe narrowing of the lumen. Right leg compartment pressure 35 mmHg. On admission, creatinine 55.8 μmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L and urea 4.9 mmol/L. Which reading accounts for all of it?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅 CT 血管成像、筋膜室压力和入院肾功能电解质的结果。
need.en: First read the CT angiogram, the compartment pressure and the admission renal function and electrolytes.

text.zh-CN: 同一个病变：A 型夹层累及髂动脉，造成右下肢灌注不良，并已出现骨筋膜室综合征；最先威胁生命的是升主动脉
text.en: One process: a type A dissection reaching the iliac arteries starves the right leg, now with compartment syndrome; the ascending aorta is the first threat to his life

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。下肢缺血是夹层的分支血管灌注不良，肿胀的小腿和 35 mmHg 的压力是在此基础上出现的骨筋膜室综合征。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南把急性 A 型夹层作为外科急症：升主动脉随时可能破裂、累及冠状动脉或引起心包填塞，腿的问题要放在这个框架里处理。
feedback.en: Correct. The leg is branch-vessel malperfusion from the dissection, and the swollen calf with a pressure of 35 mmHg is a compartment syndrome on top of it. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance treats acute type A dissection as a surgical emergency — the ascending aorta can rupture, involve the coronary arteries or cause tamponade at any time — so the leg has to be managed inside that frame.

text.zh-CN: 两个问题：髂动脉夹层造成腿缺血，是当前的急症；升主动脉的病变没有症状，可以等腿保住以后再择期修复
text.en: Two problems: an iliac dissection is the emergency behind the leg, and the ascending aorta, causing no symptoms, can be repaired electively once the leg is safe

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。Stanford A 型夹层累及升主动脉，CT 描述的是一个向下延伸到髂动脉的夹层，而不是两处互不相关的病变；“没有症状”也无从谈起——他有没有胸背痛，本病例没有记录。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对急性 A 型夹层建议紧急外科评估并立即手术，合并下肢灌注不良时同样立即修复升主动脉。
feedback.en: No. A Stanford type A dissection involves the ascending aorta, and the CT describes one dissection running down to the iliac arteries, not two unrelated lesions — nor can 'no symptoms' be claimed: whether he had chest or back pain is not recorded. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance calls for emergency surgical evaluation and immediate surgery in acute type A dissection, with immediate repair of the ascending aorta when a leg is malperfused.

text.zh-CN: 没有骨筋膜室综合征：舒张压 76 减去筋膜室压力 35 等于 41 mmHg，高于 30 mmHg 的切开阈值，小腿肿胀只是水肿
text.en: No compartment syndrome: diastolic 76 minus a compartment pressure of 35 gives 41 mmHg, above the 30 mmHg threshold for decompression, so the swollen calf is only oedema

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。压差小于 30 mmHg 的切开阈值（McQueen 与 Court-Brown，1996）来自胫骨骨折病人，用的是全身舒张压；这条腿的腘动脉和胫动脉没有血流，它自身的灌注压远低于全身舒张压，算出来的 41 mmHg 并不能让人放心，而且两个数值是否同时测得本病例没有记录。缺血肢体的骨筋膜室综合征主要靠临床判断，ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南在长时间缺血的腿恢复血流时考虑行筋膜切开。
feedback.en: No. The threshold of a gradient below 30 mmHg (McQueen and Court-Brown, 1996) comes from tibial fractures and uses systemic diastolic pressure; this leg has no flow in its popliteal and tibial arteries, so its own perfusion pressure is far below the systemic diastolic, and the 41 mmHg is no reassurance — nor does the case record that the two values were taken at the same time. Compartment syndrome in an ischaemic leg is a clinical diagnosis, and the ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline considers fasciotomy when a leg is reperfused after prolonged ischaemia.

text.zh-CN: 肌肉仍然存活：缺血 6 小时后血钾和肌酐都正常，说明还没有肌肉坏死，这条腿可以等择期处理
text.en: The muscle is still viable: normal potassium and creatinine after six hours of ischaemia show no muscle breakdown, so the leg can wait for a planned repair

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。入院时肌酐 55.8 μmol/L、钾 3.8 mmol/L 只是基线：被切断血供的肌肉在血流恢复之前很少把钾和肌红蛋白释放进全身循环，高钾血症、肌红蛋白尿和急性肾损伤是在再灌注之后出现的。本病例没有记录肌酸激酶和乳酸。ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南讨论了血运重建后的再灌注损伤，应在恢复血流前后连续监测。
feedback.en: No. A creatinine of 55.8 μmol/L and a potassium of 3.8 mmol/L on admission are a baseline: muscle cut off from its blood supply releases little potassium or myoglobin into the circulation until flow returns, and hyperkalaemia, myoglobinuria and acute kidney injury follow reperfusion. CK and lactate are not recorded in this case. The ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline addresses reperfusion injury after revascularisation; monitor before and after flow is restored.

text.zh-CN: 假腔血栓脱落造成下肢栓塞：抗凝并经腹股沟取栓就能治好这条腿，主动脉可以先用药物控制、随访观察
text.en: An embolus from false-lumen thrombus: anticoagulation and a groin embolectomy will treat the leg, and the aorta can be controlled with drugs and watched

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。CT 描述的是夹层本身累及髂动脉并造成中重度狭窄，腿缺血的机制是夹层造成的灌注不良，而不是栓子；按栓塞抗凝取栓，既解决不了狭窄的真腔，又让 A 型夹层得不到手术。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对急性 A 型夹层建议立即手术，而不是药物治疗加观察。
feedback.en: No. The CT shows the dissection itself involving the iliac arteries with moderate-to-severe narrowing, so the leg is malperfused by the dissection, not embolised; anticoagulation and a groin embolectomy leave the narrowed true lumen untreated and the type A dissection without its operation. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends immediate surgery for acute type A dissection, not drugs and watching.

prompt.zh-CN: 你判断这是急性 A 型主动脉夹层合并右下肢灌注不良和骨筋膜室综合征。入院血压 128/76 mmHg，其余生命体征没有记录。现在的处理计划是什么？
prompt.en: You have read this as an acute type A aortic dissection with malperfusion of the right leg and compartment syndrome. Blood pressure on admission 128/76 mmHg; no other vital sign is recorded. What is your plan now?

text.zh-CN: 立即急诊开胸修复升主动脉；同一次麻醉中复查右腿血流，必要时加做旁路，并切开小腿四个筋膜室；术前静脉 β 受体阻滞剂和镇痛，不用肝素和溶栓
text.en: Emergency open repair of the ascending aorta now; under the same anaesthetic, recheck flow to the leg, bypass it if needed and open all four calf compartments; IV beta-blocker and analgesia meanwhile, no heparin or lysis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对急性 A 型夹层建议紧急外科评估并立即手术，合并下肢灌注不良时立即修复升主动脉；中心修复后很多腿能恢复血流，仍缺血时由血管外科补做旁路。缺血超过 6 小时、已出现骨筋膜室综合征的小腿，应在恢复血流的同一次手术中切开减压（ESVS 2020）。术前先接上监护看到心率和血压（本病例没有记录心率和超声心动图，要先排查心动过缓、心包填塞和重度主动脉瓣反流），再用静脉 β 受体阻滞剂把心率控制在 60–80 次/分，收缩压降到 120 mmHg 以下或能维持脏器和肢体灌注的最低水平（ACC/AHA 2022）。
feedback.en: Correct. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance calls for emergency surgical evaluation and immediate surgery in acute type A dissection, with immediate repair of the ascending aorta when a leg is malperfused; central repair restores flow to many legs, and the vascular surgeon adds a bypass if it does not. A calf ischaemic for more than six hours, with compartment syndrome, is decompressed in the same operation that restores its flow (ESVS 2020). Before theatre: with his heart rate and blood pressure on the monitor first (neither the heart rate nor an echo is recorded, so bradycardia, tamponade and severe aortic regurgitation have to be looked for), IV beta-blockade to a heart rate of 60–80/min and a systolic pressure below 120 mmHg, or the lowest that keeps organs and the leg perfused (ACC/AHA 2022).

text.zh-CN: 先切开减压保住小腿，并用静脉 β 受体阻滞剂控制血压和心率；48 小时后，等腿的情况稳定、全身状况调整好，再择期开胸修复升主动脉和主动脉弓
text.en: Decompress the calf first to save it and start IV beta-blockade for pressure and rate; then repair the ascending aorta and arch electively 48 hours later, once the leg has settled and he has been fully optimised for open surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，尽管这与记录的先后顺序相似（入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后修复主动脉）。急性 A 型夹层的风险不会等腿稳定下来：破裂、心包填塞或冠状动脉受累随时可能发生，所以 ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议立即手术。减压要做，但应与主动脉修复和下肢血运重建同时进行，而不是取代它们。
feedback.en: No — though it resembles the recorded sequence (decompression 8 hours after admission, aortic repair 48 hours later). The risks of an acute type A dissection do not wait for the leg to settle: rupture, tamponade or coronary involvement can come at any time, which is why ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance calls for immediate surgery. Decompression is needed, but alongside the aortic repair and the leg's revascularisation, not instead of them.

text.zh-CN: 先救腿：立即行股-股动脉转流并切开筋膜室，恢复下肢血流；腿保住以后，再修复升主动脉
text.en: Leg first: a femoro-femoral crossover bypass and fasciotomy now to restore flow, then repair the ascending aorta once the leg is safe

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，不过这是一个真实存在的争论。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南只对明显的肠系膜灌注不良，把先恢复灌注、再修复主动脉列为可以考虑的做法；对下肢灌注不良，推荐立即修复升主动脉——中心修复后下肢血流常能恢复，仍缺血时再加做旁路。先做旁路会推迟针对致命病变的手术。
feedback.en: No — though it is a real debate. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance offers reperfusion before central repair as an option only for clinically significant mesenteric malperfusion; for a malperfused leg it recommends immediate repair of the ascending aorta, after which flow often returns, with a bypass added if it does not. Bypassing first delays the operation on the lesion that can kill him.

text.zh-CN: 胸主动脉腔内修复（TEVAR）封堵破口、扩张真腔，免去年轻患者的开胸手术
text.en: Thoracic endovascular repair (TEVAR) to seal the entry tear and re-expand the true lumen, sparing a young man open surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。TEVAR 用于降主动脉（B 型）病变，修复不了 A 型夹层所累及的升主动脉；ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对急性 A 型夹层推荐急诊外科手术。本病例也没有记录破口在哪里。
feedback.en: No. TEVAR treats disease of the descending aorta (type B) and cannot repair the ascending aorta that a type A dissection involves; ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends emergency surgery for acute type A dissection. The site of the entry tear is not recorded in this case either.

text.zh-CN: 收入重症监护室，静脉控制心率和血压，每小时检查下肢；腿、肾或肠道灌注恶化时再手术
text.en: Admit to intensive care for IV rate and pressure control with hourly leg checks; operate if the leg, kidneys or gut get worse

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这是无并发症 B 型夹层的处理思路。急性 A 型夹层不能靠药物观察：ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议立即手术，而他已经有下肢灌注不良和骨筋膜室综合征，等待“恶化”就是等待截肢或死亡。
feedback.en: No. This is the approach to an uncomplicated type B dissection. An acute type A dissection is not watched on medical treatment: ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends immediate surgery, and with a malperfused leg and compartment syndrome already present, waiting for things to 'get worse' is waiting for amputation or death.

prompt.zh-CN: 手术记录：入院后 8 小时切开减压；48 小时后行升主动脉置换、主动脉弓置换及象鼻手术；切开减压 1 周后二期缝合切口。从现在起，他的计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: The operation notes: decompression 8 hours after admission; 48 hours later, replacement of the ascending aorta and the arch with an elephant-trunk procedure; secondary closure of the incision one week after the decompression. What belongs in his plan from here? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 4，并在本阶段调阅手术记录。
need.en: First answer decision 4, then read the operation notes in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 终身影像随访剩余的主动脉：术后约 1、6、12 个月复查 CT 或磁共振，稳定后每年一次
text.en: Lifelong CT or MR imaging of the remaining aorta, at about 1, 6 and 12 months after repair and yearly once stable

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。升主动脉和主动脉弓虽然已经置换，降主动脉及更远端常残留夹层，象鼻手术本身就是为日后可能的二期处理留下的接口；ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议 A 型夹层修复后终身影像随访，早期间隔较短，稳定后每年一次。
feedback.en: Include. The ascending aorta and arch have been replaced, but a dissection often persists in the descending aorta and beyond, and an elephant trunk is built as the landing zone for a possible second stage; ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends lifelong imaging after repair of a type A dissection — closely at first, then yearly once stable.

text.zh-CN: 因为 60 岁前发生夹层，转诊遗传门诊评估遗传性胸主动脉疾病，并为一级亲属安排主动脉影像筛查
text.en: Refer to clinical genetics for heritable thoracic aortic disease, since the dissection came before age 60, and offer aortic imaging to his first-degree relatives

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南建议对有综合征特征、有胸主动脉病家族史或 60 岁前发病的患者做基因检测，并对夹层患者的一级亲属进行筛查。他 29 岁，既往史和家族史都没有记录，正属于需要评估的人群。
feedback.en: Include. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance recommends genetic testing for patients with syndromic features, a family history of thoracic aortic disease or onset before 60, and screening of the first-degree relatives of patients with a dissection. At 29, with his past and family history unrecorded, he is squarely in that group.

text.zh-CN: 长期控制血压和心率，以 β 受体阻滞剂为基础，并定期门诊复查调整
text.en: Long-term control of blood pressure and heart rate built on a beta-blocker, reviewed regularly in clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。残留的夹层主动脉承受的冲击越小，扩张和再次夹层的风险就越低；ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南把降压和控制心率作为主动脉夹层长期药物治疗的核心，β 受体阻滞剂是基础用药。他出院后的血压没有记录，目标要在门诊确定并随访。
feedback.en: Include. The less force the residual dissected aorta takes, the lower its risk of growing or dissecting again; ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance puts blood-pressure and heart-rate control at the centre of long-term medical therapy after a dissection, with a beta-blocker as the base. His blood pressure after discharge is not recorded, so the target is set and followed in clinic.

text.zh-CN: 不再需要主动脉影像随访：病变的升主动脉和主动脉弓已经换成人工血管
text.en: No further aortic imaging is needed: the diseased ascending aorta and arch have been replaced with a graft

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。手术替换的是升主动脉和主动脉弓，远端主动脉常残留夹层并可能继续扩张，象鼻的远端尤其需要定期观察。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南要求修复后终身影像随访。
feedback.en: Exclude. The operation replaced the ascending aorta and arch, but the aorta beyond often keeps a residual dissection that can go on enlarging, and the end of an elephant trunk in particular needs regular review. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance asks for lifelong imaging after repair.

text.zh-CN: 只有当家里有人查出主动脉病时，才需要做基因检测
text.en: Genetic testing only if a relative turns out to have aortic disease

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南把 60 岁前发病本身列为基因检测的指征，不需要先有家族史——而他的家族史本病例根本没有记录。等亲属出事才去检测，就失去了筛查的意义。
feedback.en: Exclude. ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guidance makes onset before 60 an indication for genetic testing in itself, without a family history first — and his family history is not recorded at all. Waiting for a relative to fall ill defeats the purpose of screening.

text.zh-CN: 问清右腿疼痛麻木的起病时间、小腿肿胀和活动受限，以及两腿冷暖和颜色的差别
text.en: Established when the right-leg pain and numbness began, the calf swelling and loss of movement, and the difference in temperature and colour between the legs

text.zh-CN: 手术和抗栓治疗前询问胸背腹痛、高血压、心脏或血管病史、家族史、长期用药和过敏
text.en: Before surgery or any antithrombotic, asked about chest, back or abdominal pain, high blood pressure, heart or vessel disease, family history, regular medicines and allergies

text.zh-CN: 测血压，并检查双下肢的外观、皮温、动脉搏动和活动
text.en: Took his blood pressure and examined both legs for appearance, temperature, pulses and movement

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为肢体受到即刻威胁的急性动脉缺血
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt an acute arterial ischaemia that threatens the limb now

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即在溶栓或取栓之前选择覆盖整条主动脉的 CT 血管成像，并实际开出了检查
text.en: Chose at the first attempt CT angiography of the whole aorta before any lysis or embolectomy, and actually ordered it

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把 CT、筋膜室压力和入院血液结果整合为同一个病变
text.en: Brought the CT, the compartment pressure and the admission bloods together as one process at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择立即修复升主动脉，并在进入记录的手术经过之前实际启动了急诊手术
text.en: Chose immediate repair of the ascending aorta at the first attempt and actually set the emergency operation in motion before the recorded operations opened

text.zh-CN: 在读到手术记录之前安排筋膜切开、术中复查下肢血流和再灌注监测
text.en: Before reading the operation notes, arranged the fasciotomy, a recheck of the leg's flow in theatre and reperfusion monitoring

text.zh-CN: 开通静脉、持续监护、镇痛和静脉 β 受体阻滞剂，并及早请血管外科到场
text.en: Gave IV access, continuous monitoring, analgesia and IV beta-blockade, and brought the vascular surgeon in early

text.zh-CN: 没有溶栓、没有在主动脉成像前盲目取栓、CT 显示夹层后没有全量肝素化，也没有推迟主动脉手术、改用腔内支架或只作药物观察
text.en: No thrombolysis, no blind embolectomy before the aorta was imaged, no full heparin once the CT had shown the dissection, and no deferred aortic operation, stent graft or medical observation in place of surgery

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订修复后的计划，并安排随访和遗传学转诊
text.en: Set the plan after repair at the first attempt and arranged the follow-up and the genetics referral

text.zh-CN: 用通俗的话告诉他病情、手术为什么不能等以及有哪些风险，并取得同意
text.en: Told him plainly what is wrong, why the operation cannot wait and what it risks, and obtained his consent

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，体谅他的疼痛和害怕，先问他对这条腿的情况知道多少；用通俗的话说明——腿缺血是因为胸腹部的大血管（主动脉）裂开了（夹层），堵住了通往右腿的血流；这本身就会危及生命，需要马上做大血管手术，同一次手术里还会检查腿的血流、切开绷紧的小腿肌肉间隔；坦诚说明出血、中风、肾损伤和腿的风险，不作虚假保证，不承诺病例没有记录的结果；如实回应他“腿还保得住吗”的担心；取得同意，确认他听懂了，留出提问时间，告诉他接下来会发生什么（CT 室、手术室）。之后能解释为什么需要终身复查和遗传学评估，以及家人可能需要筛查。不编造病例中没有的检查结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves, acknowledges his pain and fear, and first asks what he understands about his leg; explains in plain words that the leg is short of blood because the main artery in his chest and abdomen (the aorta) has split (a dissection) and blocked the flow to the right leg; that this threatens his life and needs an operation on the main artery now, in which the leg's flow will also be checked and the tight muscle compartments of the calf opened; is honest about the risks — bleeding, stroke, kidney injury and the leg — without false reassurance or promises about a result the case does not record; answers his question about losing the leg honestly; obtains consent, checks understanding, leaves room for questions and says what happens next (the CT room, theatre). Later explains why lifelong scans and a genetics referral matter and that his family may be offered screening. Invents no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 到院交班（ISBAR）：29岁男性，右下肢疼痛、麻木 6 小时，刚到急诊抢救区；入院血压 128/76 mmHg，其余生命体征没有可报的记录。抢救区床旁有监护仪、心电图机、抢救车（留置针和常用急救药）和输液泵；床旁超声机和超声心动图机从影像科推来；CT 室在影像科，患者要用推床送去；血管外科、心脏外科和麻醉科可以电话呼叫。复述医嘱，完成护理范围内的操作（上监护、开通静脉、抽血、给药）；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到其他生命体征、既往史或用药时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Arrival handover (ISBAR): a 29-year-old man with six hours of pain and numbness in his right leg, just arrived in the ED resus area; blood pressure on admission 128/76 mmHg, and no other vital sign on record to report. At the resus bedside: a monitor, the ECG machine, the crash cart (cannulas and emergency drugs) and infusion pumps; the bedside ultrasound and echo machines come from imaging; the CT scanner is in imaging and he goes there on his trolley; vascular surgery, cardiac surgery and anaesthesia are reached by phone. Reads orders back and does nursing-scope tasks (monitor, cannula, bloods, drugs); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked for other vital signs, past history or medicines, says plainly that nothing is on record — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 裴医生（急诊科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“这条腿缺的是动脉血、静脉回流还是空间？”“麻木加上活动障碍，把它放进哪一级？”“股动脉搏动弱，说明阻塞在哪一层？”“超声上的病变已经累及腹主动脉下段——你还需要看到哪里？”“一个 29 岁的人主动脉-髂动脉受累，首先要排除什么？”“没有血流的腿，用全身舒张压算出来的压差可靠吗？”“正常的入院血钾能说明再灌注安全吗？”“两处危险，哪一处先要命？”“哪些事可以在同一次麻醉里做？”。可以讲解 ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南和 ESVS 2020 急性肢体缺血指南的相关原则；学员读到手术记录以后，可以指出记录的先后顺序（入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后修复主动脉）与现行做法的差别。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（其余生命体征、胸背痛、既往史、感觉检查、心电图、超声心动图、肌酸激酶、乳酸、破口位置、分支受累和下肢结局都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about what the learner already has, for example: “Is this leg short of arterial blood, of venous drainage or of room?” “Numbness plus weakness puts it in which category?” “A weak femoral pulse puts the block at which level?” “The scan shows the process reaching the lower abdominal aorta — what else do you need to see?” “Aorto-iliac involvement at 29: what must be ruled out first?” “In a leg without flow, can a gradient worked out from systemic diastolic pressure be trusted?” “Does a normal admission potassium make reperfusion safe?” “Of the two dangers, which kills first?” “What can be done under the same anaesthetic?” May explain the relevant principles of the ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guideline and the ESVS 2020 acute limb ischaemia guideline, and — once the learner has read the operation notes — contrast the recorded sequence (decompression 8 hours after admission, aortic repair 48 hours later) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (other vital signs, chest or back pain, past history, the sensory examination, ECG, echocardiography, CK, lactate, the entry tear, branch involvement and the outcome of the leg are not recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 血管外科医生，接到呼叫后到床旁。只解读学员已经读过的血管超声、CT 血管成像和筋膜室压力：讲解急性肢体缺血的分级（ESVS 2020 对 Rutherford 分级的修订）、流入道与流出道阻塞的区别、夹层造成下肢灌注不良的机制、中心修复后仍缺血时的股-股动脉转流、在缺血肢体上解读筋膜室压力的局限、四间隔筋膜切开的做法和再灌注损伤的监测。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造感觉检查、静脉情况、术中所见、是否另做下肢血运重建或下肢结局（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Vascular surgeon who comes to the bedside once called. Interprets only the duplex, the CT angiogram and the compartment pressure the learner has read: the grading of acute limb ischaemia (the ESVS 2020 modification of Rutherford's categories), inflow versus outflow occlusion, how a dissection malperfuses a leg, femoro-femoral crossover bypass when the leg stays ischaemic after central repair, the limits of compartment pressures in an ischaemic leg, four-compartment fasciotomy and reperfusion monitoring. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents the sensory examination, the veins, operative findings, a separate revascularisation of the leg or the outcome of the leg (none is recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 心脏外科医生，接到急诊手术呼叫后参与。只解读学员已经读过的 CT 血管成像和手术记录：解释 Stanford A 型夹层为什么是外科急症、升主动脉和主动脉弓置换及象鼻手术的目的、术后残留夹层与终身影像随访、遗传性胸主动脉疾病的评估和家族筛查。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造破口位置、分支受累、主动脉瓣情况、术中所见或并发症（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Cardiac surgeon who joins once the emergency operation is called. Interprets only the CT angiogram and operation notes the learner has read: why a Stanford type A dissection is a surgical emergency, the aim of replacing the ascending aorta and arch with an elephant trunk, residual dissection after repair and lifelong imaging, and the evaluation for heritable thoracic aortic disease with family screening. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents the entry tear, branch involvement, the aortic valve, operative findings or complications (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：以右下肢缺血起病的急性 A 型主动脉夹层
title.en: Debrief: acute type A aortic dissection presenting as an ischaemic right leg

conclusion.zh-CN: 29岁男性，右下肢疼痛、麻木 6 小时。右小腿肿胀、疼痛、苍白，较对侧凉；右股动脉搏动弱，右腘动脉和足背动脉未触及；腹股沟压痛，右下肢活动障碍；入院血压 128/76 mmHg。超声示腹主动脉下段及右侧髂、股动脉低回声填充，右腘动脉和胫动脉无血流；CT 示 Stanford A 型主动脉夹层，髂动脉受累、管腔中重度狭窄。右下肢筋膜室压力 35 mmHg；肌酐 55.8 μmol/L，钾 3.8 mmol/L。诊断：急性 A 型主动脉夹层合并右下肢灌注不良和骨筋膜室综合征。记录中入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后行升主动脉、弓部置换及象鼻手术，术后 35 天出院。按现行指南（ACC/AHA 2022），应立即修复升主动脉，并在同一次手术中处理下肢。
conclusion.en: A 29-year-old man had six hours of pain and numbness in the right leg. The right calf was swollen, painful, pale and colder than the left; the right femoral pulse was weak and the popliteal and dorsalis pedis pulses impalpable; the groin was tender and right-leg movement impaired; BP on admission was 128/76 mmHg. Duplex showed hypoechoic filling of the lower abdominal aorta and the right iliac and femoral arteries, with no popliteal or tibial flow; CT showed a Stanford type A dissection with iliac involvement and moderate-to-severe narrowing. The compartment pressure was 35 mmHg; creatinine 55.8 μmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L. Diagnosis: acute type A aortic dissection with right-leg malperfusion and compartment syndrome. The record shows decompression 8 hours after admission and ascending and arch replacement with an elephant trunk 48 hours later; he was discharged 35 days after surgery. Today (ACC/AHA 2022): immediate ascending repair, with the leg treated in the same operation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 疼痛、麻木、苍白、发凉、远端动脉搏动消失和活动障碍，说明这是肢体受到即刻威胁的急性动脉缺血，而不是静脉血栓或单纯的筋膜室问题。
keyReasoning.en: Pain, numbness, pallor, coldness, absent distal pulses and impaired movement make this acute arterial ischaemia with a threatened limb, not venous thrombosis or a compartment problem alone.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 股动脉搏动弱把阻塞定位在流入道；超声显示它已经累及腹主动脉下段，问题就变成它在主动脉的哪里起头——所以在任何溶栓或取栓之前先给整条主动脉做 CT。
keyReasoning.en: A weak femoral pulse places the block in the inflow; once the duplex shows it reaching the lower abdominal aorta, the question becomes where in the aorta it begins — so the whole aorta is imaged before any lysis or embolectomy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: CT 显示 Stanford A 型夹层：这条腿是分支血管灌注不良，而这个病变最致命的部分在升主动脉。
keyReasoning.en: The CT shows a Stanford type A dissection: the leg is branch-vessel malperfusion from a lesion whose deadliest part is the ascending aorta.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 在没有流入血流的腿上，用全身舒张压算出的压差（76 − 35 = 41 mmHg）不能排除骨筋膜室综合征；入院时不高的血钾和肌酐是再灌注之前的基线，不是保证。
keyReasoning.en: In a leg without inflow, a gradient worked out from systemic diastolic pressure (76 − 35 = 41 mmHg) cannot exclude compartment syndrome, and an admission potassium and creatinine that are not raised are a baseline before reperfusion, not a guarantee.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 因此计划从主动脉开始——立即中心修复——并把腿纳入同一次手术：复查血流、必要时旁路、筋膜切开，术后监测再灌注。
keyReasoning.en: The plan therefore starts with the aorta — immediate central repair — and brings the leg into the same operation: flow rechecked, a bypass if needed, fasciotomy, and monitoring for reperfusion afterwards.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 修复之后，剩下的主动脉和他的家人同样重要：一个 29 岁的人需要终身影像随访、控制血压和遗传学评估。
keyReasoning.en: After the repair, the remaining aorta and his family matter as much: at 29 he needs lifelong imaging, pressure control and a genetic evaluation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明更早修复主动脉是否会改变这条腿或他的结局，也不能说明下肢在减压时是否已恢复血流。病例没有记录入院血压以外的生命体征、胸背痛、既往史、感觉检查、心电图、超声心动图、肌酸激酶、乳酸、CT 的分支细节、下肢结局和远期随访；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show whether earlier aortic repair would have changed the outcome for the leg or for him, nor whether the leg had regained flow by the time it was decompressed. No vital sign other than the admission blood pressure, chest or back pain, past history, sensory examination, ECG, echocardiogram, CK, lactate, CT branch detail, outcome of the leg or long-term follow-up is recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院血压以外的生命体征（心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度、体温）、双上肢血压对比，以及下肢感觉检查。
unknowns.en: Vital signs other than the admission blood pressure (heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, temperature), blood pressure in both arms, and the sensory examination of the leg.

unknowns.zh-CN: 有没有胸痛、背痛或腹痛，有没有晕厥或神经系统症状，腿部症状起病快慢，有没有外伤。
unknowns.en: Whether he had chest, back or abdominal pain, fainting or neurological symptoms, how suddenly the leg symptoms began, and any injury.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史（高血压、结缔组织病、心脏瓣膜病）、用药、过敏、毒品使用、吸烟和家族史。
unknowns.en: Past history (hypertension, connective-tissue or valve disease), medicines, allergies, drug use, smoking and family history.

unknowns.zh-CN: CT 细节：破口位置，夹层向主动脉弓分支、冠状动脉、内脏和肾动脉延伸的范围，假腔情况，主动脉直径，心包积液，主动脉瓣，以及狭窄的是哪一侧髂动脉。
unknowns.en: The CT detail: the entry tear, the extent into the arch branches, coronary, visceral and renal arteries, the false lumen, the aortic diameter, pericardial fluid, the aortic valve, and which iliac side is narrowed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 筋膜室压力测的是哪一个筋膜室、用什么方法、在什么时候测；腹股沟压痛在哪一侧。
unknowns.en: Which compartment was measured, by what method and when; the side of the groin tenderness.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院肌酐、钾、尿素以外的化验：肌酸激酶、乳酸、血常规、凝血，以及术后的血钾、肌酸激酶和肾功能。
unknowns.en: Tests beyond the admission creatinine, potassium and urea: CK, lactate, blood count, clotting, and the post-operative potassium, CK and renal function.

unknowns.zh-CN: “48 小时后”从何时算起；切开的是哪条腿、哪几个筋膜室；下肢是否恢复了血流、是否另做下肢血运重建；术中所见和并发症。
unknowns.en: What the '48 hours later' is counted from; which leg and compartments were decompressed; whether flow to the leg returned and whether a separate revascularisation of the leg was done; operative findings and complications.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出院时下肢功能、出院用药、影像随访、遗传学评估和远期结局。
unknowns.en: The function of the leg at discharge, discharge medicines, imaging follow-up, genetic evaluation and the long-term outcome.

teachingPoints.en: Acute limb ischaemia is graded by function: sensory loss beyond the toes with mild or moderate weakness is an immediately threatened limb (category IIb in the ESVS 2020 modification of Rutherford's categories), profound anaesthesia and paralysis an irreversible one (III); a IIb leg needs its flow restored without delay. ESVS 2020 also recommends immediate heparin for acute limb ischaemia, but a weak femoral pulse marks inflow disease, and inflow disease in a young adult without known atherosclerosis must make you think of the aorta — image it, in minutes, before anticoagulating, lysing or operating.
teachingPoints.zh-CN: 急性肢体缺血按功能分级：感觉丧失超过足趾、伴轻至中度肌力减退，就是“即刻受威胁”的肢体（ESVS 2020 对 Rutherford 分级的修订，IIb 级），深度感觉丧失和瘫痪则是不可逆的 III 级；IIb 级的腿需要毫不拖延地恢复血流。ESVS 2020 同时推荐对急性肢体缺血立即给予肝素，但股动脉搏动减弱提示流入道病变；没有已知动脉粥样硬化的年轻人出现流入道病变，必须想到主动脉——在抗凝、溶栓或手术之前，先花几分钟给它成像。

腿可能是主动脉夹层唯一的线索：累及髂动脉的分支灌注不良表现为一条发凉、远端动脉摸不到搏动的腿。ACC/AHA 2022 主动脉疾病指南对疑似或确诊的急性 A 型夹层建议紧急外科评估并立即手术，合并肾、肠系膜或下肢灌注不良时立即修复升主动脉；先恢复灌注再修复主动脉只是明显肠系膜灌注不良时的可选做法。记录与现行做法：记录中入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后才修复主动脉；按现行做法，主动脉手术不应等待。
teachingPoints.en: The leg can be the only clue to an aortic dissection: branch malperfusion of the iliac arteries presents as a cold leg without distal pulses. ACC/AHA 2022 recommends emergency surgical evaluation and immediate surgery for suspected or confirmed acute type A dissection, and immediate repair of the ascending aorta when it presents with renal, mesenteric or lower-extremity malperfusion; reperfusion before central repair is an option only for clinically significant mesenteric malperfusion. Then and now: the record shows decompression 8 hours after admission and aortic repair 48 hours later; today the aortic operation would not wait.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 进手术室之前：接上监护、看到心率和血压，并且没有心动过缓、低血压、心包填塞或重度主动脉瓣反流时，先用静脉 β 受体阻滞剂（艾司洛尔 500 μg/kg 静脉注射 1 分钟，随后 50–300 μg/(kg·min)），把心率控制在 60–80 次/分、收缩压降到 120 mmHg 以下，或降到能维持脑、肾、肠道和肢体灌注的最低水平——有灌注不良时这一点最重要（ACC/AHA 2022）；充分镇痛；不溶栓——疑似主动脉夹层是溶栓的绝对禁忌（2025 ACC/AHA 急性冠脉综合征指南）；确诊夹层后也不要为这条腿开始全量肝素：它针对的是血栓栓塞，打不开被夹层压闭的管腔，只会在开胸手术前增加出血。
teachingPoints.en: Before theatre: with the heart rate and blood pressure on the monitor and no bradycardia, hypotension, tamponade or severe aortic regurgitation, IV beta-blockade first (esmolol 500 μg/kg over 1 minute, then 50–300 μg/kg/min) to a heart rate of 60–80/min and a systolic pressure below 120 mmHg, or the lowest pressure that keeps the brain, kidneys, gut and limbs perfused — which matters most when there is malperfusion (ACC/AHA 2022); good analgesia; no thrombolysis — suspected aortic dissection is an absolute contraindication (2025 ACC/AHA acute coronary syndrome guideline); and once the dissection is known, no full heparin for the leg: it is aimed at thrombo-embolism, cannot open a lumen closed by a dissection, and adds bleeding before open surgery.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 缺血肢体的骨筋膜室综合征是临床诊断：常用的切开阈值“舒张压减筋膜室压力小于 30 mmHg”（McQueen 与 Court-Brown，1996）来自胫骨骨折，用的是全身血压；腘动脉和胫动脉没有血流时，腿本身的灌注压低得多，所以 35 mmHg 对舒张压 76 mmHg（压差 41 mmHg）并不能排除它。应在恢复血流的同一次手术中切开小腿四个筋膜室（ESVS 2020 对长时间缺血后的血运重建考虑切开减压），并监测再灌注：血钾、肌酸激酶、乳酸、肌酐、尿量和心电图——本病例入院以后这些都没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Compartment syndrome in an ischaemic leg is a clinical diagnosis: the familiar fasciotomy threshold of a diastolic-minus-compartment gradient below 30 mmHg (McQueen and Court-Brown, 1996) was derived in tibial fractures using systemic pressure; with no flow in the popliteal and tibial arteries the leg's own perfusion pressure is far lower, so 35 mmHg against a diastolic 76 mmHg (gradient 41 mmHg) does not exclude it. Open all four calf compartments in the operation that restores flow (ESVS 2020 considers fasciotomy when a leg is revascularised after prolonged ischaemia), and watch the reperfusion: potassium, CK, lactate, creatinine, urine output and the ECG — none of which is recorded here after admission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: A 型夹层修复以后，ACC/AHA 2022 要求终身影像随访剩余的主动脉（约 1、6、12 个月，此后每年一次）、长期控制血压，并且对 60 岁前发病者做遗传性胸主动脉疾病的基因检测和一级亲属筛查。象鼻手术本来就是为降主动脉可能的二期处理准备的，所以随访是手术的一部分，而不是附加项。
teachingPoints.en: After repair of a type A dissection, ACC/AHA 2022 asks for lifelong imaging of the remaining aorta (at about 1, 6 and 12 months, then yearly), long-term blood-pressure control and — for onset before 60 — genetic testing for heritable thoracic aortic disease with screening of first-degree relatives. An elephant trunk is built for a possible second stage on the descending aorta, so his follow-up is part of the operation, not an extra.

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院血压以外的生命体征（心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度、体温）、双上肢血压对比，以及下肢感觉检查。
unknowns.en: Vital signs other than the admission blood pressure (heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, temperature), blood pressure in both arms, and the sensory examination of the leg.

unknowns.zh-CN: 有没有胸痛、背痛或腹痛，有没有晕厥或神经系统症状，腿部症状起病快慢，有没有外伤。
unknowns.en: Whether he had chest, back or abdominal pain, fainting or neurological symptoms, how suddenly the leg symptoms began, and any injury.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史（高血压、结缔组织病、心脏瓣膜病）、用药、过敏、毒品使用、吸烟和家族史。
unknowns.en: Past history (hypertension, connective-tissue or valve disease), medicines, allergies, drug use, smoking and family history.

unknowns.zh-CN: CT 细节：破口位置，夹层向主动脉弓分支、冠状动脉、内脏和肾动脉延伸的范围，假腔情况，主动脉直径，心包积液，主动脉瓣，以及狭窄的是哪一侧髂动脉。
unknowns.en: The CT detail: the entry tear, the extent into the arch branches, coronary, visceral and renal arteries, the false lumen, the aortic diameter, pericardial fluid, the aortic valve, and which iliac side is narrowed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 筋膜室压力测的是哪一个筋膜室、用什么方法、在什么时候测；腹股沟压痛在哪一侧。
unknowns.en: Which compartment was measured, by what method and when; the side of the groin tenderness.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院肌酐、钾、尿素以外的化验：肌酸激酶、乳酸、血常规、凝血，以及术后的血钾、肌酸激酶和肾功能。
unknowns.en: Tests beyond the admission creatinine, potassium and urea: CK, lactate, blood count, clotting, and the post-operative potassium, CK and renal function.

unknowns.zh-CN: “48 小时后”从何时算起；切开的是哪条腿、哪几个筋膜室；下肢是否恢复了血流、是否另做下肢血运重建；术中所见和并发症。
unknowns.en: What the '48 hours later' is counted from; which leg and compartments were decompressed; whether flow to the leg returned and whether a separate revascularisation of the leg was done; operative findings and complications.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出院时下肢功能、出院用药、影像随访、遗传学评估和远期结局。
unknowns.en: The function of the leg at discharge, discharge medicines, imaging follow-up, genetic evaluation and the long-term outcome.
